facts.form: tape/strip of plastic film, assumed non-cellular, non-adhesive, unprinted

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3920 covers other plates, sheets, film, foil and strip of plastics, non-cellular; 3920.43 is of polyvinyl chloride containing by weight not less than 6% plasticizers

rejected_alternatives.reason: applies only if self-adhesive; none stated
printed matter; CROSS G88560 (in_force) classed printed polyethylene barricade tape there, but no printing is stated here and it is a different material, so not relied on
not made in imitation of patent leather

missing_facts: whether the tape is printed or adhesive
classification.rationale: Unprinted PVC film strip with plasticizers falls in 3920.43 (Chapter 39 note 1 defines plastics). No on-point ruling; G88560 (in_force) was examined and rejected for differing facts.
